description: Ultrasonic sensors measure tank levels at one household, with 13 and 16 data segments for two tanks. Calibration details and household-use context accompany the release. This resource is provided by Binoy Nair. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Level changes include a nightly solar-water-heater refill. They cannot all be interpreted as direct household consumption. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
